Priya: CI turned red on my PR (#3421) — only job failing is frontend-e2e (login flow timeout). Looks flaky, can someone trigger just that job without rebuilding docker images?
Marcus: yep, you can ask ci-bot to rerun the job without image rebuild. Use the comment trigger below.
Marcus: ```/ci-bot rerun job=frontend-e2e pr=3421 --no-image --preserve-cache```
Priya: nice — is that an internal slash command or GitHub comment? I don't have /ci-bot access in the org.
Marcus: it's a GitHub PR comment we expose as a bot handler. If you can't, you can also run the infra CLI:```infra run rerun --pr 3421 --workflow frontend-e2e --skip-image --keep-cache```
Priya: ah ok. do we have a safety guard to prevent rerunning older commits? I want it to run against the current head sha.
infra-bot: ci-bot: queued rerun for PR 3421, job frontend-e2e, sha=ab12cd34, options: --no-image --preserve-cache. Expected start ~30s.
Alex: if the rerun fails again, try triggering the job against the previous commit to see if it's a regression:```infra run rerun --sha <previous-sha> --workflow frontend-e2e --skip-image```
Alex: another tip: if it's intermittent only on login, add FLAG_UI_RETRY=1 in the job env to get one more attempt without changing images.
Priya: I'm going to try the PR comment since I can post there. Will report back.
Priya (edit): comment posted, infra CLI blocked me but the comment worked. ci-bot replied queued.
infra-bot: ci-bot: run started for PR 3421, job frontend-e2e, run_id=987654.
Marcus: if you want to keep logs across reruns, use --attach-artifacts or the GH run URL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/987654
Priya: rerun passed! :tada: Looks flaky. I'll add a short retry wrapper in the test to reduce noise. Thanks all.
Marcus: sweet. If this recurs we should add an alert in the console for >3 flaky fails in 24h. :thumbsup:
